# Semrush for Antigravity

A Google Antigravity plugin that connects the agent to the Semrush MCP server and bundles reusable SEO workflows built
on top of it: keyword research, technical audits, backlink and competitor analysis, SERP analysis, content briefs, and
structured data.

## What's inside

- **Semrush MCP server** — the remote server at `https://mcp.semrush.com/antigravity/v2/mcp` that provides live
  Semrush data and tools. It connects through Semrush's own sign-in flow, so there is no API key to paste.
- **Skills** — Markdown instruction sets that teach the agent how to complete one specific task the same way every
  time. Each skill lives in `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md` and is also available as `/<skill-name>` in chat.

| Category              | Skill                                              | What it does                                                                                       |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Technical SEO         | [technical-seo-audit](skills/technical-seo-audit/) | Audit crawlability, Core Web Vitals, schema, and on-page signals in one pass                       |
| Technical SEO         | [internal-link-audit](skills/internal-link-audit/) | Find orphan pages, broken internal links, depth issues, and missing hubs                           |
| Technical SEO         | [schema-markup](skills/schema-markup/)             | Audit, draft, and validate structured data without inventing entity facts                          |
| Keyword Research      | [keyword-research](skills/keyword-research/)       | Find keyword ideas with volume, difficulty, intent, and CPC, clustered by topic                    |
| Keyword Research      | [content-brief](skills/content-brief/)             | Turn one keyword into a brief a writer can ship: intent, SERP context, outline, FAQs, linking plan |
| Rankings & SERPs      | [serp-analysis](skills/serp-analysis/)             | Analyze the top 10 for any keyword: format, features, gaps, ranking strategy                       |
| Backlinks & Authority | [backlink-audit](skills/backlink-audit/)           | Audit a backlink profile: anchor distribution, toxicity, competitor gaps, broken-link recovery     |
| Competitor Research   | [competitor-gap](skills/competitor-gap/)           | Find keyword, content, and link gaps between your domain and your real search competitors          |

## Requirements

Using Semrush MCP requires an eligible Semrush subscription with API access. See
the [Semrush MCP documentation](https://developer.semrush.com/api/v4/introduction/semrush-mcp/) for details.

## Installing

In the Antigravity app, open **Customizations → Plugins**, click **+ Install from URL**, and enter this repository's
URL or a local path to a checkout.

From the terminal:

```shell
agy plugin install <repository-url-or-path>
agy plugin list
```

After installing, sign in to Semrush when Antigravity asks you to authorize the MCP server.

## Using the plugin

Describe the task in plain language — for example, *"run a technical SEO audit on example.com"* — and the agent will
pick the matching skill and follow its workflow, pulling live data from Semrush as it goes. You can also call a skill
directly, for example `/keyword-research`.

AI responses may be incomplete or inaccurate. Verify results before using them for decisions, publication, or other
critical work.

## License

Licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for attribution requirements.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how changes to this repository are reviewed and approved.
